title: Automation rules
description: Advanced: bounded rules that run on a schedule or event. New rules start disabled; you enable them explicitly. Source sync schedules stay in Data sources.
deleteDescription: Rule {name} stops and is removed from the list. Its run history is kept.
conflict.label: The rule changed elsewhere. The list was reloaded; try again.
invalidServer: The server rejected this rule. Check the trigger, actions and enabled modules.
conflict.briefSlot: Another rule already owns the daily brief schedule. Pause it first, then enable this one.
conflict.quota: The automation limit is reached. Delete a rule first.
conflict.generic: The request conflicts with the current state. The list was reloaded; try again.
pauseBeforeBriefEdit: Pause this rule before turning it into a daily brief schedule, then enable it again.
action.failed: The action could not be completed.
run.queued: Run queued. Actions that need approval wait for your decision below.
name: Rule name
trigger.label: Trigger
scheduleHelp: Minimum interval is two minutes, five when an agent runs. Source sync schedules are edited in Data sources.
conditionsHelp: All conditions must match. Fields come from the selected trigger; none are required.
actionsHelp: Actions run in the listed order and stop at the first one that does not succeed.
actionsCleared: {count} actions were removed because their module is disabled.
needsApproval: Each run waits for your approval before this action happens.
briefHelp: Generates the daily brief through the dashboard.
webhook.help: Only aliases configured for this deployment can be called; the destination address is never part of the rule.
webhook.inboundHelp: This is an owner-created alias. The token is separate from your owner sign-in.
webhook.credentialOnce: Copy this token now; it is shown once:
scope.label: Estimated scope
scope.summary: {actions} actions, {approvals} need approval per run. At most {limit} runs per hour.
scope.modelSpend: Agent actions spend model tokens when approved.
startsDisabled: The rule is saved disabled. Enable it from the list when ready.
preview.label: Preview
preview.help: Check the conditions against a sample. Preview never sends, creates or spends anything.
preview.matched: The sample matches; these actions would be planned.
err.name: Enter a rule name.
err.condition: Every condition needs a valid value for its field type.
err.action: Fill in every required action field.
noRuns: This rule has not run yet.
approval.title: Approval required
approval.revisionChanged: The rule changed after this run; the approval can no longer be given.
decisionConflict: This approval is no longer valid. Reload the history.
decisionFailed: The decision could not be saved.
chatUnavailable: No Chat conversation exists for this rule yet. It is created when its agent action starts.
